episodes.title: Escaping Rama (Part 1): Born Into The Cult
episodes.description:
Shifrah Morgan joins us to discuss her experience with the Rama Cult. 

She describes what it was like to grow up inside: the punishments, the constant hypervigilance, and how the outside world treated cult kids. 

She also talks about the few kind people who showed up for her, the violence she witnessed and how it shaped her, the trauma responses she still works through, and the abuse that happened inside other members’ homes.

This is part 1 of a 4-part series. Stay tuned for more.

⚠️ Content advisory: This episode includes frank discussion of childhood abuse, physical violence, and cult control. Viewer discretion is advised. The accounts shared are Shifrah’s personal recollections and experiences.

Grab a coffee, pull up a chair, and prepare yourself for Shifrah's experience.
